scope: Local skill audit and fact recall repair; not release acceptance

improvements.name: recall_fact_transitions_after_entity_links_change
improvements.behavior: Entity links select relevant subject/predicate/clock slots. Later ownership records remain visible from the previous holder context. Actual evidence, story time, unknown order, author plans, retired associations and dependency hashes retain their boundaries.

improvements.name: deduplicate_fact_slots_before_lookup
improvements.behavior: Collect eligible state slots globally, then query each slot once using the existing index; avoids repeated joins for every historical version.
